question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the occasions when a unit or wing was transferred from another Air Force command to USAFE, in time order.
why_needs_multiple: Cần liệt kê ba lần chuyển đơn vị từ một lệnh khác (TAC, SAC) sang USAFE trong các thập kỷ khác nhau; mỗi lần là một đợt chuyển riêng.
criterion: A unit, wing or air force was transferred or relocated into USAFE control from another USAF command (Tactical Air Command, Strategic Air Command).

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the occasions when the command's own headquarters designation was changed, in time order.
why_needs_multiple: Cần liệt kê ba lần đổi tên cơ quan chỉ huy qua các giai đoạn khác nhau của lịch sử đơn vị.
criterion: The command itself (its headquarters designation, not a subordinate unit) was redesignated or formally assumed a new designation.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the occasions when the command's headquarters moved to a different base, in time order.
why_needs_multiple: Cần liệt kê hai lần chuyển trụ sở của cơ quan chỉ huy giữa hai căn cứ khác nhau; không đủ mốc để hỏi dạng thứ tự khác.
criterion: The command's headquarters was relocated from one air base or station to another.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the occasions when US-operated sites in Turkey were turned over to Turkish control (in any order).
why_needs_multiple: Cần nêu hai đợt bàn giao các căn cứ ở Thổ Nhĩ Kỳ; mốc 1969–1973 là khoảng nên ghi 'in any order'.
criterion: US-operated facilities or air bases in Turkey were turned over to Turkish government or Turkish Air Force control.

label: founding
question: How many calendar years passed from the date USAFE's origins are traced to (the establishment of its predecessor, the Eighth Air Force) to the date it formally took its current designation?
why_needs_multiple: Cần hai mốc cách nhau cả thế kỷ để tính khoảng cách năm từ khởi nguyên đến tên hiện tại.
criterion: USAFE's origin date (establishment of the predecessor Eighth Air Force) and the date it formally assumed its current designation.
